thread:
carmen: Heads up, Zenith's security team sent a follow-up SQ. They want: (A) evidence that we use envelope encryption with tenant-specific data keys, (B) RBAC change diffs for infra service accounts for the last 90 days, (C) sample audit log export showing retention metadata, and (D) a customer-facing vuln-triage summary + escalation matrix.
leo: A) we can show the KMS envelope flow diagram + a small sample of key-wrap events from CloudTrail / Cloud Audit Logs.
mina: B) I'll run the IAM admin audit export and filter for serviceAccount principals and role change RPCs. Plan: capture SetIamPolicy, BindRole, and RemoveBinding events.
owen: C) For retention metadata we should include the log-bucket policy snippet and the retention_policy_id. I'll pull the bucket policy and an example export (redacted).
sec-bot: Created ticket SEC-3310: "Zenith SQ 1 KMS+RBAC evidence pack" assigned to @carmen,@mina,@leo,@owen. Due 2026-04-12 20:00 UTC.
carmen: Also requested: proof that fallbacks/canaries maintain tenant isolation (no cross-tenant cache). Include the routing snippet and an explicit statement on cache partitioning.
leo: Command I'll run (GCP example):
```
gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName:("SetIamPolicy" OR "SetPolicy") AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:serviceAccount' --freshness=90d --format=json > /tmp/zenith/iam_changes_90d.json
```
mina: I'll produce diffs showing `bindings_before` and `bindings_after` for each change. Large diffs summarized; full samples included in CSV.
owen: KMS rotation mapping: I'll extract key rotation events and produce CSV: `key_alias,provider,created_at,last_rotation_by,last_rotation_ts`. Tenant IDs replaced with `tz-<redacted>`.
carmen: For the vuln-triage summary they asked for: (1) detection -> (2) triage -> (3) mitigation -> (4) customer notification timeline. Provide an anonymized example for a minor vuln we closed last month. No internal ticket IDs.
leo: Also include a short postmortem redaction template showing what we remove (PII, tenant identifiers, internal runbook links).
mina: Reminder: run the PII redaction checklist before upload: https://internal.redwood/sec/redaction-checklist. I'll run a grep for email patterns and customer IDs.
carmen: Delivery format requested: ZIP with PDF README, CSVs, JSON samples, routing_policy snippet, and presigned S3 URLs that expire in 7 days. Owen, can you host under s3://redwood-evidence/zenith-4967890123/?
owen: Yes. I'll stage in /tmp/zenith_evidence then run the evidence-signing script and upload. Will set expiry=7d and include checksums.
sec-bot: Reminder: Evidence must not contain raw tenant secrets. Automated scanner will run on upload.
carmen: Timeline: Mina (RBAC export + diffs) - 3h; Leo (KMS diagram + key-wrap samples) - 4h; Owen (manifest + upload) - after sign-off. I'll review before upload and then send presigned link to Zenith.
mina: Started export now, will post redacted sample here when ready.
leo: I'll sketch the envelope diagram and attach a minimal sample Cloud Audit log line showing keyWrap step.
owen: Created staging folder /tmp/zenith_evidence. Waiting on files.
carmen: If Zenith wants live verification we can schedule a 30-min read-only session showing the evidence in the viewer. I'll offer that in the README.
sec-bot: SEC-3310 status updated -> in progress.
